headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.7 with significant improvements over previous versions

items.title: Changes in the system prompt between Claude Opus 4.6 and 4.7
items.summary: Anthropic has published a detailed update on the changes in system prompts between their Claude Opus 4.6 and 4.7 versions. The new version includes enhancements to prompt handling, offering better task completion and response accuracy. The documentation serves as a valuable resource for developers involved in creating or optimizing AI-driven chat systems. With Claude 4.7, users can expect improved performance across various conversational tasks, making this update particularly relevant for those in the chatbot and virtual assistant space.
items.why_it_matters: Understanding the changes in Claude's prompt system can help developers optimize AI chat applications for better user interaction.

items.title: openai/openai-agents-python
items.summary: OpenAI has released a new lightweight framework designed for multi-agent workflows. This Python-based tool aims to simplify the creation and management of complex agent interactions, enhancing the capabilities of AI systems that require cooperative task execution. The framework is gaining rapid popularity, as evidenced by its high star count on GitHub.

items.title: Show HN: Run TRELLIS.2 Image-to-3D generation natively on Apple Silicon
items.summary: A significant development for Mac users, TRELLIS.2 has been ported to run natively on Apple Silicon using PyTorch MPS. Originally requiring CUDA, the tool now uses pure PyTorch alternatives, making it accessible for macOS developers working on image-to-3D model projects.

items.title: DeepER-Med: Advancing Deep Evidence-Based Research in Medicine Through Agentic AI
items.summary: A new study explores the integration of AI agents into medical research, emphasizing trustworthiness and transparency. This research aims to accelerate scientific discovery by using AI to process and analyze medical data, potentially transforming how evidence-based medicine is conducted.

items.title: GIST: Multimodal Knowledge Extraction and Spatial Grounding via Intelligent Semantic Topology
items.summary: This paper presents a novel approach to navigating complex environments using AI. By leveraging dense visual features and advanced semantic topology, the study aims to improve spatial grounding for AI systems operating in dynamic settings like hospitals and warehouses.
